items.h: Power Consumption: Low power design for enterprise
Use Case: Data Center, Server, RAID Storage

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Seagate Exos 7E10 10TB Enterprise HDD is a high-capacity, reliable storage solution designed for data centers, enterprise servers, and mission-critical applications. Built with advanced CMR (Conventional Magnetic Recording) technology, this drive delivers consistent performance, enhanced data integrity, and long-term reliability.


Operating at 7200 RPM with a high-speed 12Gb/s SAS interface, the Exos 7E10 ensures fast data transfer rates and optimized workload handling. It is engineered for 24/7 operation, making it ideal for high-demand environments such as cloud storage, RAID arrays, and enterprise backup systems.


With enterprise-class features like advanced caching, rotational vibration tolerance, and enhanced error correction, this HDD provides stable performance even in multi-drive environments. The 10TB capacity allows businesses to efficiently manage large-scale data storage while reducing infrastructure costs.


Key Features


  • 10TB high-capacity enterprise storage
  • 7200 RPM spindle speed for reliable performance
  • 12Gb/s SAS interface for high-speed data transfer
  • 3.5-inch form factor
  • Built with CMR technology for consistent performance
  • Designed for 24/7 enterprise workloads
  • Enhanced rotational vibration (RV) sensors
  • High reliability with enterprise-grade durability
  • Optimized for RAID and multi-bay environments
